summary: Pulsenmore Ltd., an Israeli med-tech company, filed a Form 6-K on August 17, 2026, reporting a press release about the Israel Innovation Authority approving a $1.27 million grant for its SmartScan AI program. This is the second AI grant, totaling approximately $1.6 million, supporting programs with a combined scope of $3.12 million. The grant funds a 12-month R&D project for AI-powered real-time ultrasound guidance. This is a routine grant announcement, not a special situation; no deal terms are applicable. The filing does not involve acquisitions, divestitures, or other corporate actions.
